responsibility: This source file implements NDS32 expansion helpers for memory block operations and multiword memory instructions. It generates optimized cpymem, setmem, and strlen loops or unrolled sequences using load/store-multiple, post-increment forms, alignment checks, and V3M-specific unaligned handling, and it constructs the PARALLEL RTL templates consumed by nds32-multiple.md for load_multiple and store_multiple patterns, making it the backend’s dedicated memory-manipulation expander module.
